title: Machine Learning for Urodynamic Detection of Detrusor Overactivity
summary: The study uses pediatric urodynamics files from two machines at one institution (1,154 total, 810 cystometry; file-level train/test split) to detect detrusor overactivity; time-based model AUC 91.9%, frequency specificity 91.7%. Limited retrospective diagnostic result.
